alerts.invalidLink: That YouTube link was not recognised. Paste a link such as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=… or https://youtu.be/…
alerts.needsServer:
YouTube cannot play videos when the page is opened as a local file (file://).

Open it through a small local server, for example:
  python3 -m http.server 8000
then go to http://localhost:8000/
alerts.youtubeFailed: The YouTube video could not be loaded:
alerts.unplayableVideo:
This video cannot be played by the browser.

Try an .mp4 file (H.264 + AAC audio) or a .webm. .mkv files are often silent: their audio track (AC-3, DTS) cannot be decoded by a browser.
alerts.startFailedHint: Check that the camera is allowed and that the computer is online (needed the first time the model loads).

youtube.embeddingDenied: The owner of this video does not allow it to play outside YouTube. Try another video.
youtube.blockedHere: This video is blocked from playing on this page (embedding or origin restriction). Try another video, or open the page over http://localhost.
